title: workload-fidelity-scaler-and-regression-harness-for-golden-run-comparisons
author: Claire Jensen
description: Motivation: performance regressions are brittle when synthetic workload shapes diverge from production distributions. This PR introduces a workload fidelity scaler and an accompanying regression harness that can morph baseline workload traces to target fidelity envelopes and run deterministic golden-run comparisons. Summary: adds a fidelity scaler module that applies stretch/compression, sequence-length mixing, token-velocity perturbation, and concurrency jitter models to archived trace inputs, plus a harness that runs multiple seeded replays, captures per-step latency/p99/p50 and KV-cache hit statistics, and outputs a compact regression report suitable for automated triage. This is intended to reduce noisy flaky regressions by enabling tuned synthetic runs that better approximate customer traffic shapes. Key behaviors: (1) fidelity profiles are declared as YAML with named envelopes (low-latency-mobile, bursty-ad, long-context-retrieval) and can be composed at runtime; (2) the scaler supports deterministic RNG seeds for reproducible golden runs; (3) harness integrates with perf-db to store run artifacts and with the reporting pipeline to emit a delta-summary JSON. Backwards compatibility: existing canonical trace formats are accepted and unchanged; new optional metadata fields are namespaced under "fidelity.v1". Test plan: added unit tests for scaling transforms, integration test that replays a 10k-step trace under three fidelity profiles and verifies metrics within expected bands, and an end-to-end costume nightly job that runs on perf-canary. Rollout: feature gated behind benchmark_lab.fidelity_scaler flag; default off for all CI lanes. Related: ENG-1089 (reduce noise in e2e perf signal).

diff_snippet:
--- a/benchmark-lab/fidelity/scaler.py
+++ b/benchmark-lab/fidelity/scaler.py
@@ def scale_trace(trace, profile):
-    # previous naive resampler
-    return simple_resample(trace, ratio=profile.ratio)
+    # new fidelity pipeline: sequence mix -> token velocity -> concurrency jitter -> kv-tagging
+    trace = apply_sequence_mix(trace, profile.sequence_mix)
+    trace = apply_token_velocity(trace, profile.token_velocity)
+    trace = apply_concurrency_jitter(trace, profile.concurrency_jitter)
+    return trace
discussion: Anjali Rao: Nice approach. Two questions: (1) how do you ensure the scaled trace doesn't accidentally move the workload into an unsupported path in the runtime (e.g., very long KV cache misses)? (request change)

Claire Jensen: We add a safety clamp step that maps sequence length and cache-miss ratio into a conservative window; default profiles include conservative clamps. Added unit tests that assert clamps are applied.
Dmitri Petrov: Please add a compact CSV summary export so SRE alerts can ingest run deltas quickly. (requested)
Claire Jensen: Added delta-summary CSV writer and wired it into perf-db uploader; included schema in docs. Ready for re-review.
Samir Patel: Ran the 10k replay under 'bursty-ad' profile and saw a 7% median latency uplift but 18% reduction in false-positive regression noise compared to naive resample. Approving. ✅
review_decisions: Requested changes addressed: safety clamps + CSV export
Approvals: 1/3 approvals initially, final: Anjali Rao approved, Dmitri Petrov approved, Samir Patel approved
merge_commit: m4f9c2b squash: workload fidelity scaler and regression harness
release_notes: Introduce fidelity scaler and regression harness: add fidelity profiles, deterministic replays, safety clamps, perf-db integration, and nightly job (feature-flagged).
impact_summary: When enabled, the fidelity scaler reduced flaky perf regression alerts by ~18% on canary workloads in initial runs. The scaler increased median latency in bursty profiles by up to 7% compared to naive resampling; this is expected and documented in profiles. The harness enables automated golden-run comparisons and stores artifacts in perf-db for triage.
testing_instructions: To reproduce: export a canonical trace (tools/trace_exporter), pick a profile from benchmark-lab/fidelity/profiles, run golden_run_harness.py --trace /path/to/trace --profile bursty-ad --seed 42 --out /tmp/run; upload artifact with perfdb_uploader --run /tmp/run
notes: Feature gated and opt-in; QA should validate that existing CI lanes remain unchanged. Ops: consider enabling 'low-latency-mobile' profile for pre-merge smoke to catch regressions in mobile-like patterns.
